use: one soft keyboard key: a single letter or word typing on
sync: the key bottoms out 11 ms in: at = the frame the letter appears

sync: first key at 11 ms: at = the frame the label starts typing

name: asmr-tick-fine
use: a watch-like micro tick: one step of a count, a small value changing, a grid cell
sync: onset 3 ms

name: asmr-count-roll
use: a roll of fine ticks slowing down along the Stat count-up curve (30 frames, BEZ.countUp); pair with land at the landing frame. With Stat landAt the count runs longer: start the roll at the count, it ends early, which is right because BEZ.countUp has covered 97 % of the value at half time
sync: first tick at 3 ms = the frame the count starts; the last tick lands before 960 ms, so land can take the landing frame

name: asmr-count-roll-long
use: the same roll for Stat values of 100 000 and more (36 frames)
sync: first tick at 3 ms = the frame the count starts; the last tick lands before 1160 ms, so land can take the landing frame

name: asmr-land
use: a number lands: felt thump with a tiny wood knock on top (the app's landed, closer and softer)
sync: onset 3 ms: at = the landing frame (not landAt - 1)

name: asmr-knock

sync: onset 3 ms

name: asmr-tap

name: asmr-pencil-short

name: asmr-pencil-long
